component.name: MathCAS v2
component.summary: A free computer algebra system with notebooks

description.p: MathCAS v2 is a computer algebra system: exact and arbitrary-precision arithmetic, algebra, calculus, differential equations, linear algebra, special functions, number theory, and 2D and 3D plots, in a notebook with typeset output.

ul.li: Symbolic integration, limits, series, sums, transforms and equation solving, with answers that are checked before they are returned
Numbers to any precision, with proved enclosures of special functions
Plots that can be turned, zoomed and exported as PNG, SVG and PDF
A documentation window with a page of examples for each of about 1,900 functions
A terminal REPL, a Jupyter kernel and a language server in the same package

screenshot.caption: A notebook with a calculation and a plot

description.p: The AppImage carries the keyboard libraries its window needs under X11.
The Linux packages run on older systems (glibc 2.35), and a Flatpak bundle is attached to each release.
Packaging for more stores; no change to the calculations.
Limits onto branch cuts, real roots of analytic equations proved complete, faster plots and special functions, a build for Intel Macs, and many corrections.
